name: Reed clump
description: A clump of reeds and rushes for the rim of a pool, about 0.6 m across and 1.2 m high: long flat olive blades bending outwards from a dark wet mud base, some with dry tan tips, thin round rushes between them and a few brown bulrush heads on tall stalks.

provenance.prompt: A clump of reeds and rushes for a pool rim, about 0.6 × 0.6 × 1.2 m.
